free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0: 'Limited coding sessions' and 'Vibe for code for agentic coding in your terminal'; Pro is USD 14.99 a month excluding taxes with 'All-day coding in the CLI, IDE, or on web', and verified students pay USD 5.99 a month for Pro
free_tier.notes: the CLI draws on a monthly plan budget shared across Studio, the API and Vibe Code whose size is published for no plan; Vibe Code Web counts sessions instead, 2 a day on Free where access is enabled and 100 a day on paid plans

interface_detail: the Vibe CLI (`vibe`), the VS Code extension, ACP clients such as JetBrains IDEs, and Vibe Code Web on GitHub repositories in a cloud sandbox. Headless: `vibe --prompt` (`-p`) runs one task and exits, with `--auto-approve`, `--max-turns`, `--max-tokens`, `--time-limit` and `--output text|json|streaming`; only the CLI has a non-interactive mode
tooling: Vibe CLI, Apache-2.0, installed with `uv tool install mistral-vibe` or the install script; sign-in by browser or a key from Code > Vibe CLI in the MISTRAL_API_KEY variable; config presets also point the same CLI at other OpenAI-compatible providers
chaining: the plan budget is the same pool that Free mode API keys draw on (inference/mistral-la-plateforme), so CLI use and API use on one Organization spend one allowance; Pro and Team continue past the budget at API rates only when prepaid pay-as-you-go is enabled

limits.value: a monthly included usage shared across Studio, the API and Vibe Code; with pay-as-you-go off, the default, Vibe Code can stop until the next billing period. The size of the allowance is not published for any plan
Vibe Code Web: 2 sessions per day for Free users where access is enabled, 100 sessions per day for paid users; maximum session duration 24 hours, inactivity timeout 3 hours

binding_note: the monthly plan budget is what stops the CLI, and its size is unpublished; the per-day session cap applies to Vibe Code Web only

identity_cost.detail: a Mistral account with a verified phone number, and no card. Help centre copies archived on 2026-05-18 and 2026-08-05 state that the free API plan needs 'a verified phone number (one phone number per plan)' and that one phone number cannot be used across multiple free subscriptions, such as Vibe's free plan. The live account article of 2026-10-30 no longer carries its phone section and the live docs state only 'no credit card required', so whether the phone step still applies today is unverified: behind a sign-up. No country restriction is stated; a third-party guide reports a Taiwan number receiving the code. Pro is a paid subscription

reliability_note: paid-plan users report the CLI failing with 'Rate limit exceeded for mistral (model: mistral-vibe-cli-latest)' during ordinary use (GitHub issue mistralai/mistral-vibe#740, opened 2026-06-03); one commenter reports reaching the monthly limit after 4 days
confidence_note: plans, the headless flags, the shared budget and the Web session caps are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-10-30. The Free and Pro budget sizes are shown only after sign-in, so no token capacity is stated; a measured CLI run on a Free account would move the quota to measured.
